author: The Infographics Show
description:
Incognito Mode doesn’t make you anonymous online, and it may reveal far more about you than you think.

When you open a private Chrome window, your browsing history and cookies are removed from your device after you close it. But that’s about where the privacy ends. Your IP address is still visible, your internet provider can still see which domains you visit, websites can still run tracking scripts, and browser fingerprinting can identify your device using details like your screen resolution, operating system, installed fonts, graphics hardware, and browser configuration. Even disabling cookies doesn’t necessarily stop it.
Techniques like canvas fingerprinting can generate a unique identifier for your device in milliseconds, while tools such as Google Analytics and advertising networks continue collecting data inside private browsing sessions. That gap between what users thought Incognito Mode did and what it actually did eventually led to a $5 billion class-action lawsuit against Go
title: You Need to stop Using INCOGNITO Mode Right Now

author: The Infographics Show
description:
Semaglutide changed weight loss forever, but what is actually happening inside your body when you take Ozempic or Wegovy?
The answer starts with GLP-1, a hormone released by your gut after you eat. GLP-1 helps regulate insulin, slows how quickly food leaves your stomach, and sends signals to the brain that reduce hunger. Natural GLP-1 disappears within minutes, but semaglutide was engineered to survive for roughly a week. That’s why a single injection can suppress appetite for days.

This video breaks down how semaglutide works, why it can reduce “food noise,” and how scientists eventually traced the story back to research involving the Gila monster and a peptide called exendin-4.
Clinical trials have shown average weight loss of around 15% of body weight, while separate studies have linked semaglutide to cardiovascular, kidney, and other health benefits. But the drug also comes with trade-offs. Rapid weight loss can include significant lean muscle loss. Nausea and vomiting are common
title: Everything Ozempic Changes About Hunger and Fullness
